
  ╭─────────────────────────────────────────────╮
  │  /show                                      │
  │  Show Last Written File                     │
  ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Summary:
    Display the content of the last file written by the agent.

  Usage:
    /show
    /show all

  Details:
    Shows the last file RadSim wrote, with line numbers. In teach
    mode, annotations are highlighted in magenta.
    
      • (no args) — Show last written file
      • all       — Show all files written this session

  Examples:
    $ /show
    $ /show all

  Tips:
    Tip: Press S during a write confirmation to preview code.

  Related: /teach
